query: FeCoNi is an fcc alloy with high saturation magnetization and a low coercive field. Earlier studies examined the high-entropy alloys FeCoNiPd and FeCoNiPt, but both exhibited soft ferromagnetism. A qualifying high-entropy alloy must have an almost equiatomic multicomponent composition and configurational entropy of at least 1.0R. Subject to these constraints, what single intervention could produce a FeCoNi-based high-entropy alloy with greater coercivity than the prior derivatives? Present one hypothesis that identifies the intervention, explains its mechanism, predicts the outcome relative to an appropriate FeCoNi-based baseline, defines the conditions over which it should apply, cites supporting observations from earlier work, and proposes a discriminating experiment with an explicit falsification criterion.

generation.hypothesis: The introduction of Ti as a fifth element in the FeCoNi alloy to form FeCoNiTi, with an almost equiatomic composition, will increase the coercivity due to the lattice distortion caused by the differences in atomic size between Ti and the other elements.
generation.intervention: Addition of Ti to form FeCoNiTi with a composition of Fe30Co30Ni20Ti20
generation.conditions: The alloy must have an almost equiatomic multicomponent composition and configurational entropy of at least 1.0R
generation.structural_mediator: Lattice distortion caused by the differences in atomic size between Ti and the other elements
generation.mechanism: The lattice distortion will lead to an increase in the magnetocrystalline anisotropy, resulting in a higher coercivity
generation.predicted_outcome: The coercivity of FeCoNiTi will be at least 20% higher than that of FeCoNi, with a coercive field of at least 100 Oe compared to the baseline of 80 Oe for FeCoNi
generation.baseline: FeCoNi alloy with a coercive field of 80 Oe
generation.boundary: The intervention will only be effective if the Ti content is between 15 and 25 at.%
generation.uncertainty: The actual increase in coercivity may vary depending on the exact composition and processing conditions of the alloy

falsification_experiment.design: Prepare FeCoNiTi alloys with varying Ti content and measure their coercivity using a vibrating sample magnetometer
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the coercivity of FeCoNiTi with 20 at.% Ti is not at least 10% higher than that of FeCoNi, the hypothesis is falsified
